text:
anna_sales: Quick heads-up — Mosaic (POC) needs procurement/legal help. They want split billing across 3 cost centers, net-60 payment, and a DPA redline that removes the 'subprocessor blanket consent' clause. Also asking the order form to show both reserved capacity + per-token overage. Can legal + finance advise?

jess_se: I talked to their infra lead yesterday. POC requires dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) for predictable perf. Fallback to hosted for spikes. Pricing proposal below — for internal review only: 

```
Product: Redwood Dedicated (POC) - 2xA100 reserved
Term: 3 months POC
Monthly commit: $18,000
Overage (hosted fallback): $0.004 / token
Private VPC setup: $2,500 one-time
Split billing: show three invoice lines for cost centers (engineering, research, ops) with % allocation
```

jess_se: Also they asked that the order form include an explicit clause about model pinning and rollback windows for the POC. Happy to add language.

mike_legal: @anna_sales thanks. On the DPA redline — removing blanket subprocessor consent is plausible but we need to offer an alternative: either (a) a short list of approved subprocessors with notice + 30-day objection, or (b) commit to prior written consent for new subprocessors for regulated data. Which does Mosaic prefer?

anna_sales: They said in the call they'd prefer the prior written consent approach for regulated workloads, but will accept the approved list + notice for non-regulated POC data.

mike_legal: Ok. I'll draft a narrow redline: (i) carveout for POC telemetry, (ii) prior written consent for new subprocessors handling regulated data, and (iii) a 30-day notice for other subprocessors. Will attach a redline doc in a bit.

sophie_finance: Net-60 is unusual but not impossible for enterprise POC. We need Mosaic's vendor legal name, W-9/EIN (or EU VAT), and PO numbering scheme. For split billing: confirm if they want three separate invoices or one invoice with internal chargebacks. Separate invoices need vendor setup per cost-center — that'll push onboarding time by ~5 business days.

anna_sales: They want one invoice that lists three cost-center lines (preferred). I'll request W-9 + PO number format.

tim_account_exec: For signature routing — Mosaic prefers CFO sign + delegated procurement approver. Proposed envelope flow:
```
1) Mosaic: Procurement approver (sign)
2) Mosaic: CFO (sign)
3) Redwood: Legal (countersign)
4) Redwood: Sales/AE (final confirm)
```
Can legal confirm that order? Also, do we need an exec signature for the MSA or just the orderform?

mike_legal: Order form needs authorized signatory; MSA countersigned by our legal rep is fine for POC. If Mosaic asks for exec signature on MSA we can escalate, but try to keep to order form signers.

jess_se: Small technical ask for infra: Mosaic will want a short SSO cert exchange and an allowlist for egress IPs. @anna_sales can you collect the SSO cert + list of public IPs? We can schedule VPC setup once we have them.

anna_sales: Will collect. sending quick checklist to Mosaic now.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope (env_0x9a) created by anna_sales. Recipients set per proposed flow. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env_0x9a

anna_sales: Next steps: (1) @mike_legal to upload DPA redline and order form redline by EOD, (2) @sophie_finance to confirm net-60 approval and invoice format constraints, (3) @jess_se to confirm VPC onboarding ETA once SSO/IPs received, (4) I'll request W-9 + PO mapping from Mosaic and kick the envelope. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:
